issues.description: The problem statement text uses the short identifiers 'inscribedStudents' and 'guestStudents' when listing required attributes, but the UML, test names, and the solution implementation use the more explicit identifiers 'numberOfInscribedStudents' and 'numberOfGuestStudents'. This inconsistency in naming within the problem materials can confuse students about the exact attribute names and corresponding getter/setter method names they should implement.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the attribute names consistent across the problem statement and UML. Update the textual list of required attributes in problem_statement.md (lines 16-18) to use 'numberOfInscribedStudents' and 'numberOfGuestStudents' (matching the UML, test names, and solution). Alternatively, add a clarifying note that 'inscribedStudents' and 'guestStudents' refer to the numeric attributes 'numberOfInscribedStudents' and 'numberOfGuestStudents'.
